title: 第1695章 龙争虎斗第1694章 乾坤宝玉
lines: 乾坤宝玉！
此话一出，厅中几人均是目露惊骇，便是始终一言未发的萧红渝与轩辕宁汐两位家主，相视一眼，也瞧见对方目中的讶色。
以她们的见识，自然知晓这位列第三的天地奇物。
当然，前者仅是惊讶，可后者却有些苦涩。
“哦？没想到洪道友竟然认识此宝，不错，此玉正是那乾坤宝玉。王道友觉着此宝能否换这最后一尊玄兽令的席位？”剑尊者咧嘴一笑，接着视线便落在了王扶身上。
可不等王扶开口，一旁的轩辕洪却是阴沉开口：
“剑尊者还真是舍得，去一趟玄兽界也未必能得到此等宝物吧，尊者就不怕到时候得不偿失？”
“这就不劳洪道友关心了，再说此宝于莫某而言，也没什么用处，若能换得去一趟那仙人洞府的机会，实在是划算得紧呐。”剑尊者咧嘴一笑，言辞却没有半点客气。
轩辕洪闻言，脸上阴沉更甚，但却无话可说，若是旁人，他倒是可借轩辕家的势力强行抢夺，以势压人，但面前这二人，一个是成名已久的剑道大尊者，一个是亲手灭杀了叶无苍的凶人。
纵使轩辕家，也无法得罪。
他也只能大袖一甩，以示不满。
“看来洪道友拿不出胜过此玉的宝物，那这最后一尊席位便归莫某所有了……王道友以为如何？”剑尊者笑眯眯地看向王扶。
“自当如此。”王扶点头一笑。
随后他也毫不客气地大手一挥，将那乾坤宝玉收入囊中。
如此，排名前五的天地奇物，他竟得了四种，虽说造化母气早已被炼化消失，但毕竟拥有过了。
“哈哈……好！那莫某就等着王道友的通知了，届时玄兽界开启之时，可别忘了通知莫某。”剑尊者见王扶收下了乾坤宝玉，脸上笑容更甚几分。
可接着他好似又想到了什么，瞧了一眼坐于末尾的陆商，不由又道：
“我看王道友这弟子的修为距离炼虚境也不远矣，似乎随时都可准备突破，要不王道友给莫某一份凭证，也免得莫某错过。”
“既是剑尊者要求，自无不可。”王扶虽有些奇怪，但还是点头同意。
随后他略微一想，手指一动，一缕剑丝凝结，一转之下瞬间化作一枚剑印，并屈指一弹下，悬浮于剑尊者身前。
“五行剑道！果然是那一部剑典。”不曾想剑尊者瞧见面前剑印，却忽然一叹，目中复杂一闪而逝。
王扶却未多言，他已然猜到这位尊者的目的，这才以剑道之法作为凭证。
此事一了，几人自然不便多留，毕竟是轩辕洪邀请，可到头来却什么也没得到，再呆下去，王扶还真担心此人直接赶人了。
随后一番表面的客气，一行人便离开了阁楼，朝着世家之争的广场飘然而去。
剑尊者与叶紫儿自然一同前往。
不过剑尊者此行本就只是为了玄兽令之席位而来，观礼只是顺带。
“莫前辈，我先与师尊一道。”空中，叶紫儿笑嘻嘻的说道。
“去吧去吧，不过此次盛事结束，叶丫头你还是要同我回天山修行，魔劫将至，你这点修为还远远不够，以姜前辈的话来说，至少也要让你突破合体，才能有几分自保之力。”剑尊者倒是没有拒绝，只是叮嘱了一番。
叶紫儿身怀九灵剑体，也就比他的先天剑体弱上几分而已，且有那【九玄真仙剑经】存在，若成合体大圆满，甚至比他的实力还要恐怖，可是整个天山圣地的香饽饽，只可惜这剑经只有一半，但饶是如此，这丫头也极为重要。
他此番进入玄兽界，有一部分原因便是为了那【九玄真仙剑经】的另一半，人族上一位拥有九灵剑体的先辈在玄兽界窥见仙影，从而感悟出此剑经，他未必不能有所获。
当然，更重要的还是找寻那一丝突破大乘境的可能。
“莫前辈放心，紫儿省的。”叶紫儿美目一定，欠身道。
剑尊者微微颔首，随后与王扶相视一眼，一步迈出便消失在原地，却并非离去，而是去了不远处属于天山的那一座阁楼之中。
世家之争，四大圣地均有长老前来观礼，当然如剑尊者这般的强者，却是极少前来的，若非叶紫儿，剑尊者或许直接离去也说不定。
content_en:
Qiankun Baoyu!
As soon as these words came out, everyone in the hall looked horrified. Even the two family heads, Xiao Hongyu and Xuanyuan Ningxi, who had never said a word, looked at each other and saw the surprise in each other's eyes.
With their knowledge, they naturally know this third-ranked wonder of heaven and earth.
Of course, the former was just surprised, but the latter was a little bitter.
"Oh? I didn't expect Fellow Daoist Hong to know this treasure. Yes, this jade is the Heaven and Earth Treasure. Fellow Daoist Wang, do you think this treasure can replace the seat of the last Mysterious Beast Order?" Master Jian grinned, and then his eyes fell on Wang Fu.
But before Wang Fu could speak, Xuanyuan Hong on the side spoke gloomily:
"Senior Jian is really willing to give up. You may not be able to get such treasures even if you go to the Mysterious Beast Realm. Are you not afraid that the gains will outweigh the losses?"
"I don't care about Taoist Brother Hong. Besides, this treasure is of little use to Mo. If you can exchange it for a chance to go to the Immortal Cave, it's really a good deal." Master Jian grinned, but his words were not polite at all.
When Xuanyuan Hong heard this, his face became even more gloomy, but he had nothing to say. If it were someone else, he could use the power of the Xuanyuan family to snatch it away and use his power to overwhelm others. But the two people in front of him were a long-famous swordsman, and the other was the murderer who killed Ye Wucang with his own hands.
Even the Xuanyuan family cannot be offended.
He could only wave his sleeves to show his dissatisfaction.
"It seems that Fellow Daoist Hong can't come up with a treasure better than this jade, so the last seat will belong to Mo... What do Fellow Daoist Wang think?" Master Jian looked at Wang Fu with a smile.
"It's natural." Wang Fu nodded and smiled.
Then he waved his hand unceremoniously and put the Qiankun Baoyu in his bag.
In this way, he actually obtained four of the top five wonders of heaven and earth. Although the Mother Qi of Creation had long been refined and disappeared, he had it after all.
"Haha... Okay! Then Mo is waiting for the notification from Fellow Daoist Wang. When the Mysterious Beast Realm opens, don't forget to notify Mo." Seeing Wang Fu accept the Heaven and Earth Jade, Lord Jian smiled even more on his face.
But then he seemed to think of something again, glanced at Lu Shang sitting at the end, and couldn't help but say:
"I see that this disciple, Fellow Daoist Wang, is not far from the Void Refining Realm. He seems to be ready to break through at any time. If not, Fellow Daoist Wang can give Mo a certificate to prevent Mo from missing out."
"Since it is the request of Master Jian, I can do whatever I want." Although Wang Fu felt a little strange, he still nodded in agreement.
Then he thought for a moment, moved his finger, and a wisp of sword silk condensed. With a twist, it instantly turned into a sword seal, and with a flick of his finger, it floated in front of the sword master.
"Five Elements of Swordsmanship! It is indeed that sword canon." Unexpectedly, when Master Jian saw the sword seal in front of him, he suddenly sighed, and the complexity in his eyes flashed away.
Wang Fu didn't say much. He had already guessed the venerable's purpose, so he used the method of swordsmanship as proof.
Once this matter was over, it was naturally inconvenient for a few people to stay any longer. After all, they were invited by Xuanyuan Hong, but in the end they got nothing. If they stayed any longer, Wang Fu was really worried that this person would kick them out.
After being polite on the surface, the group left the attic and drifted towards the square where the families were fighting.
Master Jian and Ye Zier naturally went together.
However, Master Jian was only here for the seat of the Mysterious Beast Order, and watching the ceremony was just a side trip.
"Senior Mo, I will go with Master first." Ye Zier said with a smile in the air.
"Go ahead, go ahead. But after this event is over, Ye Yatou, you still have to go back to Tianshan Mountain with me to practice. The calamity is coming, and your cultivation level is far from enough. According to Senior Jiang, at least you have to break through the body to be able to protect yourself." Lord Jian did not refuse, but just gave some instructions.
Ye Zier possesses the Nine Spirit Sword Body, which is only a few points weaker than his innate sword body, and with the existence of the [Nine Mysterious True Immortal Sword Scripture], if it becomes a perfect combination, it will even be more terrifying than his strength. However, it is a pity that this sword Scripture is only half of the most popular thing in the Tianshan Holy Land, but even so, this girl is also extremely important.
Part of the reason why he entered the Mysterious Beast Realm this time was for the other half of the [Nine Mysterious True Immortal Sword Sutra]. An ancestor of the human race with a nine-spirit sword body glimpsed the shadow of the immortal in the Mysterious Beast Realm, and thus understood this Sword Sutra. He may not be unable to gain something.
Of course, the more important thing is to find the possibility of breaking through to the Mahayana realm.
"Senior Mo, don't worry, Zi'er will save you." Ye Zi'er must have beautiful eyes and bowed.
Lord Jian nodded slightly, then looked at Wang Fu and took one step before disappearing. However, he did not leave, but went to the attic belonging to Tianshan Mountain not far away.
During the family dispute, elders from all four holy places came to watch the ceremony. Of course, powerful men like Master Jian rarely came. If it weren't for Ye Zi'er, Master Jian might have left directly.
